players.name: Jalen Suggs
players.outlook: Suggs is looking to build on a season in which he averaged 13.8 PPG and a career-high 5.5 APG across 57 games. He shot just 33.9% from three, but was much better in catch-and-shoot situations, hitting 39.3% of those attempts. He is slotted to be the Warriors' starting center this season, and when he plays he will produce, but he is risky to draft in fantasy leagues before the late-middle rounds at the earliest.

Plantar fasciitis remains a concern, but he’s a player fantasy managers should take a late round flier on if his scoring and playmaking continue to develop.
